name: files
title: Files
summary: An org drive: folders and files with versions, previews, sharing with people, teams and public links, trash, a storage quota, and item types other features add (repositories).

env.name: FILES_ORG_QUOTA_GB
env.doc: Storage each organization's drive may use, in GB, counting every version and the trash. 0 turns the quota off.

env.name: FILES_MAX_UPLOAD_MB
env.doc: Largest file one upload may be, in MB (S3 takes up to 5 GB in one upload).

env.name: FILES_TRASH_DAYS
env.doc: Days a trashed item stays restorable before it is deleted for good.

env.name: FILES_DELETED_ACCOUNT_KEEP_DAYS
env.doc: Days a deleted account's private My drive items stay in the org's trash (org admins can restore them) before they are purged. 0 deletes them with the account.

env.name: FILES_PUBLIC_DOWNLOADS_PER_MIN
env.doc: Public-link previews and downloads one IP address may start per minute.

stitch: Decide who may create top-level shared folders: the files.create_shared_folders permission defaults to owners and admins (Settings → Permissions). Members can always share folders from their own drive.

Set FILES_ORG_QUOTA_GB and FILES_MAX_UPLOAD_MB for your plan, and FILES_DELETED_ACCOUNT_KEEP_DAYS for what happens to a departing person's private files (default: org admins can restore them from the trash for 30 days; 0 deletes them with the account). Say which in the privacy policy.

Production storage: keep the files/ prefix private in the bucket policy, and allow PUT from the web origin in the bucket's CORS rules (uploads go straight to S3). Downloads are presigned GETs with a forced Content-Type and Content-Disposition, so nothing else needs to be public.

Put Files where it belongs in navigation: it ships as a web nav entry and Home tile and a mobile Home entry; promote it to a mobile tab if the drive is central (add <Tabs.Screen name="files"> in mobile/app/(tabs)).
Link to drive items from other features with files.ItemLink(id) (/files/<id>); features with their own item types call files.RegisterItemType in their New (FEATURE.md → Extending).
Public links open on the web at /f/<token> (wired into web/proxy.ts). Configure universal links for PUBLIC_WEB_URL/f/* only if you add a native public screen.
